definitions.explanation: A small, dark spot on the skin caused by a concentration of pigment cells.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{口元|くちもと}→口元：11891_kuchimoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{黒子|ほくろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She has a mole near her mouth.

examples.japanese: {黒子|ほくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had surgery to remove a mole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{泣|な}き{黒子|ぼくろ}→泣き黒子：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦チャームポイント→チャームポイント：11214_chaamupointo⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The mole under her eye is her charming feature.

notes:
{黒子|ほくろ} refers to a small, dark spot on the skin (a mole or beauty mark). The word is usually written in hiragana (ほくろ) in everyday use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒子|ほくろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a mole
- {黒子|ほくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove a mole
- ⟦{泣|な}き{黒子|ぼくろ}→泣き黒子：noentry⟧: mole under the eye ("crying mole")
- {黒子|ほくろ}⟦{除去|じょきょ}→除去：14567_jokyo⟧: mole removal

WRITING:
The kanji {黒子|ほくろ} uses ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ (black) + ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧, but this reading is irregular (⟦{熟字訓|じゅくじくん}→熟字訓：24368_jukujikun⟧). In a different context, ⟦{黒子|くろこ}→黒子：26786_kuroko⟧ refers to a stagehand in kabuki theater who wears all black.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Moles in certain positions — especially near the mouth (⟦{口元|くちもと}→口元：11891_kuchimoto⟧) or under the eye — are sometimes considered attractive features (⟦チャームポイント→チャームポイント：11214_chaamupointo⟧) in Japanese and East Asian cultures.
